Unleashed still holds stock, customers and invoices: Your Unleashed account keeps customers, stock, batches and invoices. We store the guide for each customer and the orders they send from our app. You keep each guide's prices current in our admin; whether they can update from Unleashed is a question for the demo.

B2B Store shoppers can keep shopping: Accounts that enjoy shopping in Unleashed's B2B Store, with its payments and reorders, can carry on there. Our app serves the chefs who would rather not browse a store at all.

Missing-order alerts still do their job: If you run Unleashed's CRM, keep its alerts for accounts that go quiet. What changes is the answer: the chef can respond by ordering in our app, not by dictating to a rep.

@graph.name: Three steps, and Unleashed stays as it is
@graph.description: Setting up needs no Unleashed login and installs nothing in it: we work from a spreadsheet you export. If you later want orders loaded through EDI or the API, the demo covers what that needs on your side.

step.name: Send us an account export
step.text: An export from Unleashed of each account's usual items and prices is usually all we need.

step.name: We set up your accounts' guides
step.text: We build every account's guide under your item codes and open the account. The chef downloads the app, and most kitchens are ordering in it the same day.

step.name: Chefs place their own orders
step.text: Each order arrives checked by the chef, numbered, timed and in the format you chose, with no rep in between.

@graph.name: Do we need an Unleashed Software alternative to let chefs voice their orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Unleashed carries on handling your stock, pricing and B2B Store. What changes is who enters the order: the chef dictates it in our app, reviews each item and hits send, instead of passing it to a rep.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Unleashed Software?

acceptedAnswer.text: For one job, yes: getting each order straight from the chef, so your reps can sell. Stock, batches, purchasing and invoicing are Unleashed's work, which is why we would not call ourselves an Unleashed Software alternative.

@graph.name: Unleashed has a B2B Store already. What does an app add?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unleashed's store suits customers who like to browse, check stock, pay by card and reorder, and you can keep it. Since 2024 it has also been one place reps enter orders for the accounts they visit. Our app is for the chef who finds talking quicker than typing, so the order does not have to go through the rep.

@graph.name: Can't other tools already bring orders into Unleashed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. An app listed in Unleashed's own integration marketplace uses AI to turn emailed order files, PDFs and spreadsheets into sales orders. Other companies also sell tools that read orders arriving by email, text or voicemail. Those work on something the customer has already sent, or give the customer an app to type into. With ours, the chef speaks the order and looks over each item before it goes, so it reaches you without a rep writing it up.

@graph.name: Is there a link between Unleashed and VoiceOrder Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not directly. We and Unleashed are different companies; neither has built a link to the other, and each supports only its own product. If your account accepts files by EDI or through the API, an order can load into Unleashed with no retyping; we confirm that in the demo. By email, it arrives with an attachment listing every item the chef approved, so your staff key it in from that list instead of a rep's notes or a voicemail.

@graph.name: Will our reps still take orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: If a customer wants that, yes: a rep can still put one through the store or key it in for them, and some chefs will keep calling. Fewer chefs lean on a rep once they can order on their own. Phoned orders get no number from us, while each order sent through the app gets its own number and time.

@graph.name: What does it cost, and how soon can we start?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases a distributor is ready in 24 to 48 hours, since nothing inside Unleashed has to change. Unleashed publishes prices for its plans, add-ons and onboarding; we quote per distributor. An Unleashed Software replacement would mean moving your stock records, batches and customers somewhere new. Our app changes how chefs send orders, and that is all it touches.
